name: Barycentric Splat Parameterization
aliases: Splat center derivation from mesh faces
definition: A method to constrain 2D Gaussian Splat centers to lie on triangular mesh faces using barycentric coordinates, allowing splats to move freely on the face while preserving per-splat attributes.
summary: Barycentric Splat Parameterization binds Gaussian splat centers to triangular mesh faces using barycentric coordinates, explicitly linking scales and orientations to local geometry rather than learning unconstrained parameters.
